exclusion_basis: Exact identity with MORNING-ATLAS/NGCC sign-15; a public full-parameter ATLAS-128 design attack recovers an equivalent signing key and produces fresh-message forgeries.

attack_history_note: No public attack against exact ECLIPSE was located; related attacks against weakened PRISM, PRISM-id, and auxiliary-isogeny constructions do not target this exact scheme.
audit_note: A scoped paper-level audit tested structured-composite primality, the scalar verifier, canonical response encoding, derived-key adaptation, and deterministic-stream framing without finding a practical full-parameter signing compromise. The cited ECLIPSE source remains private, so exact decoder and serializer checks are deferred until release.

attack_history_note: No public attack against exact ASTRA-Sign was located. Published attacks on earlier QC-LDGM, QC-LDPC, and HWQCS signatures concern materially different signing equations.

family: structured multivariate UOV signature over extension fields
attack_history_note: UFOs retains the Frobenius-UOV construction and interface but replaces the exponent schedules used by the published predecessor forgery. The original schedules are known-broken; no public attack against the fixed UFOs v1 replacement schedules was located.
